verification_notes: Method: the session's WebSearch budget was used up (200/200), so verification used WebFetch on pcf.fr programme pages (moyen_1, moyen_2, moyen_3, objectif_1, objectif_2, nationalisation_total, petition page), Wikipedia FR and EN (Fabien_Roussel, Taxe_Zucman, Cannabis_en_France) and fabienroussel2027.fr. No cross-lean press corroboration was possible.

General: the detailed programme on pcf.fr is the 2022 'La France des jours heureux' text (180 proposals). The pcf.fr homepage presents it in a 2026 context, but fabienroussel2027.fr (candidacy announced 6 Sept 2026, slogan 'Vivre') has no detailed programme yet. Source dates were changed from '2026-10' to '2022 programme, still hosted Oct 2026' where applicable.
